spans.s: + कर्मन् चूडा- + कर्मन्, n. the ceremony of tonsure, []
† चुड् चुड्, or बुड् बुड्, i. 6, Par. To cover.
† चुड्ड् चुड्ड्, i. 1, Par. To dally, to wanton (or to guess, to act).

चूड,
 I. m. or n. The ceremony of cutting the hair.
 II. f. डा.
 1. A single lock of hair left on the crown of the head at the ceremony of tonsure.
 2. The hair.
 3. The ceremony of cutting the hair.
 --Comp.
-चूडक, A substitute for -चूदा, when the latter part of a comp. adj., e. g. निर्वृत्त-, i. e. निस्- (vb. वृत्), adj. One whose head has been shorn,
चूडा + ल, adj., f. ला, Having a tuft of hair on the crown of the head,
+ मणि चूडा- + मणि, m. a jewel worn in a crest or diadem, Hit. i. d. 211, M.M. (चन्द्र-अर्ध-, adj. having the crescent for his crestjewel).
